title: feat(bem): Make the searchBox BEMish
body:
I've also updated the `poweredBy` as well. I've changed the logic of
adding inline `style` to using a specific class (defined in the
default `css` file). I've switched the display/hide logic. We no
longer need to define a `display=true` in the props to show it, but
a `hidden=true` to hide it instead.

BREAKING CHANGE: The `poweredBy` component now expect a `hidden=false`
to be hidden, instead of a `display=true` to be displayed.

comments.body: No need to modify it but it's "feat(searchBox)" BEM is not a feature per se :D
I'll remove the display/hide logic from the poweredBy component completly in another PR.
